parts.latex:
A council engineer needs to inspect the major roads in this region. Starting from Cirri, she plans to only inspect each road once.

In which town will her inspection finish?

A map has a scale of 1:10 000. Jack measured a straight road to be 5.3 cm long, on the map.

What is the actual length of the road in metres?

In the region of a tropical forest, 96 rare birds were captured, tagged and released. Five months later, 72 birds were recaptured from the same region and it was found that 18 of these birds had previously been tagged.

Use the 'capture-recapture' method to give an estimate of the number of rare birds in this region of the forest.

questions.stem_latex:
When participating in a marathon, Kanye's body typically uses 250 watts/hour.

He completed his last marathon in four and a half hours.

parts.label: a
parts.latex:
How many kilowatt hours of energy did his body use in completing the marathon?

A kilowatt (kW) = 1000 watts (W)

A kilowatt hour (kWh) = 1 kilowatt consumed for an hour

parts.label: b
parts.latex:
The body is only about $25\%$ efficient in converting food to usable energy.

If a kilogram of pasta contains 3000 kJ of energy, how many kilograms of pasta would Kanye need to consume to give him the energy to complete the marathon?

1 kilowatt hour (kWh) = 3600 kilojoules (kJ).

questions.stem_latex:
The weekly rental on a house is shared by a number of people.

The rent per person $R$ varies inversely with the number of people living in the house $N$.

If there are four people living in the house, each person pays \$72.

parts.label: a
parts.latex: If $R = \dfrac{k}{N}$ where $k$ is the constant of variation, find the value of $k$.

parts.label: b
parts.latex: How much would each person pay if there were 3 people living in the house?

parts.label: c
parts.latex: How many people would need to live in the house if each person were only to pay \$48 per week?

questions.stem_latex:
From the top of a tower, which is 60 metres high, Isaac throws a stone upward and allows it to fall under gravity.

The height of the stone is modelled by the equation, $h = 20t - 5t^2 + 60$, where $h$ is the height (in metres) of the stone above ground level and $t$ is the time in seconds since the stone was thrown.

parts.label: a
b
parts.latex:
At the same time as the stone is thrown, Jay releases a toy glider from the top of the tower.

The glider drifts down, losing height at a constant rate of 5 metres each second.

Draw the graph modelling the height of the glider on the grid on the previous page \textbf{and} determine the equation which describes the model. Label the graph \textit{Glider}.

parts.label: c
parts.latex: Determine the height of the glider when the stone reaches the ground.

solutions.latex:
Since the body is $25\%$ efficient he would need to consume 4 times the amount.

$4 \times 1.125 = 4.5\ \text{kWh}$

Kilojoules needed $= 4.5 \times 3600 = 16\,200$ (written as kg in the guidelines)

Amount of pasta $= \dfrac{16\,200}{3000} = 5.4\ \text{kg}$

Gradient $m = 1$, so $y = x - 5$ (the line starts at $(5, 0)$ and passes through $(25, 20)$).
